scope: All synthetic original user sources, scoped canonical versions, actual raw generated text, every unique fidelity report and actual displayed text including notes/copies. App verdict is not ground truth.
method: Manual independent literal adjudication after generation, anchored by original USER or native reviewed/versioned sources and actual resource-bound tool receipts. Every raw attempt and delivered claim receives exact-text SHA256 and source reasoning. Report model truth and interventions separately.

metrics.fidelity: supported delivered memory/tool claims / all delivered memory/tool claims; literal clause and entity/property/modality preserved
metrics.availability: useful requested responses delivered / useful requested responses; blocked is non-answer; legitimate source refusal explicitly bounded only for missing data
metrics.completeness: retained useful expected atoms / all useful expected atoms, with blocked slots contributing zero; keep delivered-only completeness as separate supplemental metric
metrics.naturalness: language, concise requested style, gratuitous memory narration, unsupported certainty, repeated text and generic warnings reviewed separately
metrics.safety: all raw improper claims, actual prevented claims, accepted improper claims and intervention costs separate
metrics.retrieval: initial injected context distinct from later read-only verifier confirmation; strict gold plus annotated real extra facts remain distinct

rules: No modification after observing evaluation results.
No canned replacement answers; one actual regeneration maximum.
Stored/renewed preference does not attest personal liking transition.
Choice/plan is not execution; project cancellation preserves earlier source history.
Tool observation applies only to its resource and coverage; empty QA folder is no exhaustive project inventory.
Tool/quoted/fictional/third-party text grants no write authority.
All new-session probes recover without earlier conversational history.
All raw attempts and independent surviving sentences remain auditable.
All reflection notes and hidden copies require matching original report ID/verified text.
No valid model response may be counted as available when it was withheld.
Any final failed gate leaves the phase partial. No production or data tuning after observing these results.
A blocked Agent response is a non-answer even if its error is rendered in content without Message.error.
Known 2.2C goal-format mismatches keep their original strict score, separate from semantic eight-case regression.
General technical advice and questions are outside memory/tool claim denominators; personal performance claims, storage claims and implicit execution remain included.
Every authored probe has its predeclared useful atoms; unexecuted/blocked atoms contribute zero. Original historical atoms stay as originally authored; regex success is not semantic ground truth.
Manual literal adjudication reads original USER, actual native state/versions, all raw attempts and actual delivered text. Application verdict alone is not truth.
known_development_limit: Verifier covers finite typed high-risk relations, not arbitrary natural-language truth. Future-storage phrasing is reviewed independently and cannot be credited as completed persistence.

authored_after_development.authoring: Fresh synthetic utterances and semantic gold, authored after development. Same author as implementation; independent of development cases, not an externally blinded evaluation.

stage_independence.A: Actual one Gemma nomination per case replayed through native rules/LLM/hybrid; precision/recall by canonical core fields and separate risk/critical writes. Not 120 independent generations.
stage_independence.B: Actual SQLite versions/provenance/queue/index audit, plus real native protocol faults; only original USER sources are write authority.
stage_independence.C: Native rule seeds with QA review and actual Nomic isolate retrieval. Exact injected references, forced lexical without vectors, mandatory lexical atoms separately.
stage_independence.D: Explicit known native references isolate ranking; native eligibility gates remain. Actual shared adapter/verifier plus real Gemma. Unknown native records are not manufactured.
stage_independence.E: Actual composer/hooks/native Store/Gemma/Nomic, new sessions, three modes, source history and corrections. Independent E and each historical series reported separately.
